Hello Friends!
In today’s video, we bring you the latest on-ground update from Raipur–Visakhapatnam Expressway’s Package-01, covering the stretch from Mahanadi Bridge to Abhanpur in Chhattisgarh.
This package is being built by Shalimar Corp Ltd., and most of the construction is nearly complete
We’re comparing the current status with footage from February 2025 to show what has changed
Major updates on underpasses, VMS boards, toll plazas, lane markings, and pending sections
Important insights from Bharda, Mendaraka, Abhanpur & NH-30 Junction
